facts.fact: The Universal Service and Access Fund, funded by mandatory contributions from telecom operators and administered by USAASA, was collecting money: the department's entities collected R249 million in 2021-22 rising to R281 million in 2025-26, R1.2 billion over the five years (The Citizen, citing a parliamentary reply).

The fund's expenditure is given as R1.08 billion against R1.6 billion in rollover funds, with R567 million of digital migration inventory written off in the last financial year (2025-26); the story gives collections and spending but does not name the year beside the R1.08 billion, so the latest year is taken from context.
